trap.label: distinguish from
trap.wrong: Distinguish a trend of a fad.
trap.right: Distinguish a trend from a fad.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa “distinguir de” e escolhe of ou between. Em inglês, distinguish A from B; também differentiate between.

mcq.q: I can’t ___ one cousin from the other.

fix.wrong: I can’t say one cousin from the other.
fix.right: I can’t tell one cousin from the other.

rewrite.prompt: Use tell: “I can’t distinguish one cousin from the other.”
rewrite.answer: I can’t tell one cousin from the other.
